tools.name: get_crypto_flow
tools.description: Fetch real-time Level 2 orderbook flow and behavioral velocity court verdicts for crypto assets (e.g., BTCUSDT). Outputs a risk assessment, spoofing detection, and liquidity event warnings.

symbol.description: The crypto symbol pair to analyze, e.g., 'BTCUSDT'

tools.name: get_equity_flow
tools.description: Fetch real-time institutional and retail order flow, dark pool indications, and behavioral court risk analysis for US Equity (e.g., AAPL, NVDA).

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol to analyze, e.g., 'AAPL'
